Query_RunLog_ById.description: RunId is unique (a fresh guid() per run, see Initialize_RunId in wf-copy-invoices) and is also the RowKey Upsert_RunLog writes - filtering on the RunId property directly (no PartitionKey restriction needed) returns exactly one row, matching wf-daily-digest's own 'no partition restriction... simplest at this scale' decision.

Query_Files_ById.description: Per-file detail for the CSV attachment - every file this specific run touched, regardless of current status (a later run could have since changed a file's status; this snapshot reflects what happened in THIS run specifically, matching the user's request for a digest scoped to 'that run itself').

Query_Abandoned_Backlog.description: Same all-time, not-time-bounded backlog wf-daily-digest shows (decision: a failure never silently scrolls out of view) - an on-demand run's digest should surface the SAME unresolved backlog, not just this run's own files, so finance/accounting always sees the complete current picture regardless of which digest they're reading.

Compose_RunRow.description: The single RunLog row for this runId - Upsert_RunLog writes exactly one row per run, so first() is safe. Composed once so downstream expressions don't all repeat the same first(body(...)?['entities']) lookup.

Build_CSV_Rows.description: Same RFC 4180 + CSV/formula-injection escaping as wf-daily-digest's Build_CSV_Rows (security review, 2026-08-02) - duplicated here rather than factored out because Select actions cannot be shared across workflows without their own child-workflow call, which would be disproportionate for a single string-building step.

Compose_CSV_Content.description: TriggeredByWorkflow column added 2026-08-11 - see wf-daily-digest's Compose_CSV_Content for rationale.

Call_Send_Digest_Email.description: Delegates all HTML branding/formatting to the single shared template (wf-send-digest-email) also used by the scheduled daily digest, so an on-demand run's immediate email always looks identical to the daily one (decision, 2026-08-10 - user request).
